title: Joint WHO–China study report published
evidence_described: Report of the WHO-convened joint study team, including its hypothesis rankings
notes: Evidence creation date unknown: the report cover carries no date (S02 review). Underlying study records, decision records and the approval of ranking language are not part of this release (see F01).

title: Director-General's same-day objection to the joint report's laboratory assessment
evidence_described: Internal disagreement with the joint report, disclosed in a Member State briefing statement
notes: Discloses dissent rather than primary evidence. When the disagreement first arose internally is not documented, so lag is unknown. Later public criticism (S04, 15 July 2021) and WHO's August 2021 statement (S05) could be recorded as follow-on events.

title: The Lancet addendum expanding Daszak's competing-interest disclosure
evidence_described: Expanded competing-interest disclosure covering EcoHealth's NIH-funded work in China
notes: Published online 21 June 2021; issue dated 26 June–2 July 2021 (S18). The date of the original contribution being corrected is not in the source register, so lag cannot be computed. Whether the correction was prompted by an outside request is not documented here. Completeness of the expanded disclosure has not been assessed.

title: SAGO preliminary report published, including recorded dissent
evidence_described: SAGO preliminary recommendations, including the dissent of three members on further laboratory investigation
notes: No finding in cases/covid-origins/findings.csv currently cites S06; a positive observation under D.4.3 (recorded dissent) may be warranted.

title: HHS inspector general audit of NIH and EcoHealth award monitoring
evidence_described: Audit A-05-21-00025: monitoring and reporting findings, auditee responses and EcoHealth's disagreements
notes: Completeness is 'summary' because the audit reports on records rather than releasing them. Resistance is 'contested' because EcoHealth disputed key findings (S13). The audit also records that EcoHealth could not obtain WIV documentation (see DE-2023-006).

title: WHO statement that Chinese CDC market-sample data should have been shared three years earlier
evidence_described: Market-sample data held by the Chinese CDC; WHO's public criticism of its delayed sharing
notes: The event recorded is WHO's 17 March 2023 statement about the data, not the data release itself. When, how and to whom the data were shared, and how completely, are not documented in this repository. WHO characterised the delay as about three years ('could have – and should have – been shared three years ago', S17); that characterisation is WHO's, so lag_days is left empty.

title: House Select Subcommittee majority report reproducing Proximal Origin Slack excerpts
evidence_described: Report with reproduced excerpts of Proximal Origin authors' Slack messages and emails
evidence_holder: Proximal Origin authors (message custodian not documented)
releasing_party: US House Select Subcommittee, Republican majority
release_claim: Release describes 'previously unrevealed Slack messages and emails' (S19).
notes: Evidence_created gives the month of example excerpts seen (2 and 21 February 2020, S20), not a full range, so lag_days is not computed. How the committee obtained the messages is not documented in the source register. Two near-identical report files (Final-Report-6.pdf, linked from S19; Final-Report-7.pdf, S20) carry the same title and date; differences not compared (F18). Establishes public availability by this date, not first disclosure of each message.

title: Public publishes a Proximal Origin Slack and email cache
evidence_described: Files labelled 'Proximal Origin Slack' (47 MB) and 'Proximal Origin Emails' (184 MB)
evidence_holder: Proximal Origin authors (message custodian not documented)
release_claim: Publisher describes the release as the 'full cache' (S21).
notes: Source of the cache is not documented in this repository. 'Full cache' describes what the publisher released, not the completeness of all communications; files not downloaded, hashed or compared (research/slack-release-provenance.md).

title: HHS determination debarring the Wuhan Institute of Virology, hosted by a House committee
evidence_described: Uncontested debarment determination, including the finding that requested laboratory notebooks and electronic files were not supplied
releasing_party: US House Select Subcommittee, Republican majority
notes: Created date is the digital signature date (S14); the date the committee first posted it is not established, hence 'on-or-after'. No copy on an HHS or SAM.gov page was found on 2026-11-17 (SAM.gov search robots-disallowed), so the publicly reachable copy depends on a third-party host. How the committee received it is not documented.

title: WIV original laboratory notebooks and electronic files requested by NIH, not produced
evidence_described: Original laboratory notebooks and electronic files requested to assess a grant-compliance question
notes: Year in the ID is the year the non-production was first publicly documented in sources held here (S13, 25 January 2023). Date(s) of NIH's requests are not recorded in the source register. 'Refused' reflects HHS's finding of repeated failure to supply (S14); the inspector general also records WIV's earlier cooperation with monitoring (S13). Debarment runs through 16 July 2033 (S14).

title: HHS debarment notices for EcoHealth Alliance and Peter Daszak, hosted by a House committee
evidence_described: Two notices of five-year debarment, with signatory names redacted
notes: Notice texts are undated; 17 January 2025 comes from the file names and the committee's same-day release (S15, S16). No HHS or SAM.gov copy found on 2026-11-17. A bounded search found no appeal or modification; SAM.gov records not checked.

title: SAGO independent assessment and WHO announcement
evidence_described: SAGO's 2025 assessment, including its account of requested information that was not provided
notes: Discloses the existence of unmet requests (see DE-2025-003). Process metadata only; the project has not reproduced SAGO's scientific review.

title: Early sequences, market-animal and laboratory information requested by WHO/SAGO, not shared
evidence_described: Requested early infection sequences (including a request for 508 early sequences), market-animal information and laboratory information, and access to verify laboratory conditions
notes: Year in the ID is the year the outstanding requests were documented in SAGO's assessment (27 June 2025). Request dates are not recorded in the source register; S07 (pp. 38–40) would need rereading for them. Status reflects S07/S08 as of June 2025; later developments not checked.

title: Senate HSGAC majority release of Proximal Origin Slack messages
evidence_described: Two PDF files (slack-drop-AM.pdf, slack-drop-pm.pdf) of Slack messages
evidence_holder: Proximal Origin authors (message custodian not documented)
release_claim: Announcement describes the documents as 'newly released' (S22).
notes: Page dated 22 July 2026 (metadata modified 29 July 2026); some reporting uses 21 July, not rechecked. Messages from the same channel were public by July 2023, but item-level overlap has not been compared, so the novelty claim is unverified, not inaccurate. How the committee obtained the files is not documented.
